newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $115/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $115/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday were trading lightly at $115.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, up $1.00 from top prices reported Monday and last week, market sources said.
Between 3,000 and 5,000 head had traded, including a few at $71.00 on a live basis, the sources said.
Further asking prices at some feedyards shifted to $116.00/dressed and $72.00/live, sources said.
Support was tied to light supplies of market-ready cattle on this week's showlist, which was pegged near 53,000 head total in Nebraska.
The total number of cattle available was near the number for sale last week but down about 4,000 from earlier estimates.
